<thought>Now that we have the correct functional group names, we can search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks a ketone and a C‑C double bond and forms an aliphatic hydroxyl and a five‑membered ring, which matches the carbonyl‑ene cyclization we need.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC[C@@]1(O)C(F)(F)F",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "five-membered rings"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
